organs.mechanism: 10 islands; a prompt's island is uniform; when more than 4 h of wall time have passed at a registration, islands are sorted by best score (tiny random tie-break) and the lower half are replaced by new islands seeded with the best program of a random survivor
organs.failure_landscape: by reading: resets happen only inside register_program (no registrations, no resets); a program can land on an island reset after its prompt was made

organs.mechanism: a program's signature is the tuple of its per-test scores in sorted key order; its scalar score is the score of the LAST key in insertion order, not an aggregate
organs.failure_landscape: by reading: partial score dicts (failed tests) give a different signature and possibly a different 'last' test

organs.mechanism: clusters are drawn with replacement by softmax(score / T), T = 0.1 * (1 - (n mod 30000) / 30000); within a cluster a program is drawn by softmax of minus its length normalised by the maximum (a weak preference for short code); the two chosen are ordered by score in the prompt
organs.failure_landscape: by reading: with replacement, the same cluster can fill both prompt slots

organs.mechanism: LLM output is trimmed line by line until it parses; a per-test score is kept only if the run succeeded, did not call an ancestor and returned a number; a program registers if at least one test passed
organs.failure_landscape: by reading: the sandbox raises NotImplementedError as shipped
